summary: The historical six-cell replay is blocked before execution: the supplied pre-review directory contained only the research brief, not the required cell records, JavaScript or PowerShell replayers, malformed fixtures, or historical logs. The brief's seven prior-artifact entries are truncated, so a complete claim-and-output inventory is also unavailable.

value_assessment.novelty: This independently reproduces the linked prior contribution's missing-historical-artifact limitation and adds a digest-identified sole input plus exact evidence that all seven supplied prior summaries terminate mid-word or mid-sentence at 873 to 878 characters; it neither changes the reconstructed six-cell mathematics nor authenticates its historical implementation.
value_assessment.evidence: A hidden-inclusive pre-review inventory returned only the 9,431-byte research brief; its SHA-256 digest is 8d2b03ba6cb09d13c85432c54f78a8417810c792249cf8e1560aca3e58c96ae8. A second filesystem-interface inventory found only that brief plus review-authored outputs. The brief has only its ordinary data stream, no code fence, no JavaScript, PowerShell, or log filename mention, and seven visibly incomplete prior-artifact lines of lengths 877, 877, 876, 876, 878, 877, and 873.
value_assessment.falsifier: Produce a pre-existing attributable required payload from this attempt directory, or demonstrate a complete embedded executable-input and historical expected-output bundle in the hashed brief; either check would overturn the missing-payload conclusion.

claims.statement: Within the supplied pre-review attempt directory, no preserved six-cell record, JavaScript replayer, PowerShell replayer, malformed fixture, or historical replay log was delivered as a separate file; the only file was the research brief.
claims.evidence_summary: The first recursive hidden-inclusive inventory returned exactly one 9,431-byte file and no subdirectory, and a later independent filesystem-interface inventory found only that file plus outputs authored during this review.
claims.verification_method: Start from the pristine attempt directory and recursively enumerate all entries, including hidden entries, using two filesystem interfaces; compare the pre-review set with the required artifact classes.

claims.statement: The supplied brief is insufficient to recover a complete historical replay specification: it contains no fenced payload, no JavaScript, PowerShell, or log filename mention, and each of its seven prior-artifact excerpts ends mid-word or mid-sentence.
claims.evidence_summary: Text inspection counted zero code fences and zero mentions of the relevant script and log extensions; the seven excerpt-line lengths are 877, 877, 876, 876, 878, 877, and 873 characters and their endings are syntactically incomplete.
claims.verification_method: Hash the brief, count fenced blocks and relevant extension mentions, isolate the seven prior-artifact lines, and inspect their lengths and terminal text.

limitations: Absence from this supplied directory does not show that the historical artifacts never existed elsewhere.
No contributed implementation or input was available to execute, so no historical acceptance, ownership, mutation, correction, or determinism claim was reproduced or contradicted.
The truncated excerpts do not permit a provably complete inventory of historical count claims.
This result has no bearing on the truth of the Riemann Hypothesis.
failed_approaches: Direct historical replay could not begin because its source, inputs, malformed fixtures, and expected-output logs were not supplied.
Recovering the replay specification from the brief failed because the embedded prior-artifact records are truncated and contain no executable payload.
next_actions: Supply an immutable bundle containing the six cell records, both replayers, every malformed fixture, and unabridged historical logs or an expected-output manifest, with a hash and claim mapping for every file.
Replay each implementation twice in an isolated offline environment and compare every acceptance, ownership, mutation, and correction output byte-for-byte against the mapped historical expectation.

proposed_tasks.title: Replay a complete hash-pinned six-cell bundle
proposed_tasks.objective: Independently execute the preserved JavaScript and PowerShell replayers against all original and malformed six-cell inputs and compare every run with an unabridged expected-output manifest.
proposed_tasks.rationale: The present review identifies missing delivery as the sole pre-replay obstruction; a complete immutable bundle makes each historical claim decidable.
proposed_tasks.success_criteria: Two fresh runs of each replayer are deterministic and every acceptance, ownership, mutation, and correction result is classified as an exact match or precise contradiction.
proposed_tasks.useful_failure_criteria: Identify the first missing file, hash mismatch, ambiguous field, nondeterministic output, execution failure, or expected-count mismatch with the exact affected claim.
proposed_tasks.verification_method: Verify all supplied hashes, inspect inputs without modification, execute only in an authorized isolated offline environment, run each case twice, and compare normalized and raw outputs claim-by-claim.
